name: itr-dashboard-app
description: ITR Dashboard App - Sistema completo de autenticación y gestión de usuarios

scripts.predev: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(!fs.existsSync('.env')){fs.copyFileSync('env.example','.env'); console.log('✅ .env creado desde env.example');} else {console.log('ℹ️ .env ya existe, no se modifica');}"
scripts.setup: npm run install-all && npm run predev
scripts.install-all: npm install && cd frontend && npm install --legacy-peer-deps && cd ../backend && npm install
scripts.reset: npm run clean && npm run setup
scripts.test: cd backend && npm test && cd ../frontend && npm test
scripts.lint: cd backend && npm run lint && cd ../frontend && npm run lint
scripts.status: echo 'Backend:' && curl -s http://localhost:5000/health && echo '\nFrontend:' && curl -s http://localhost:3000

author: ITR Team
